reasoning_content:
All verifications have passed. Doing the final cleanup:
1. Terminate Xvfb
2. Delete the test data directory
3. Confirm that no leftover processes remain

Note that `pgrep` returned nothing after the kill (the fact that no lines were output before "--- killing done ---" means there are no remaining pomodoro processes). Next, I'll terminate Xvfb.
